title: RWA vault architecture spec with gate-to-component mapping
description:
Deliverable: docs/architecture/p08-rwa-vaults.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) every catalog gate (compliance_pack, kyc_flag) maps to an enforcing contract/module with the exact check named; (2) the dry-run-to-live promotion procedure is defined step by step including the 48h timelock and 2-of-3 multisig; (3) the yield-only-after-gate invariant is stated with the revert condition.
Constraints: fee 15 bps on distributions, target APR 8%, max_alloc_pct 0.10, min capital $500, live_blocked=true.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Solidity interfaces for vault, gate, and KYC registry
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p08/interfaces/IRWAVault.sol, IComplianceGate.sol, IKYCRegistry.sol with NatSpec.
Acceptance criteria: (1) compiles under solc 0.8.24 with zero errors and zero warnings; (2) deposit, gate-check, yield-accrual, and redemption signatures are fixed and versioned; (3) the gate is consulted on every yield-bearing path by interface contract.
Constraints: ERC-4626-style share math; pull-pattern payouts.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: RWA vault economic model: yield sources, 15 bps fee, risk budgets
description:
Deliverable: docs/economics/p08-rwa-economics.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) model reproduces the 8% target APR under documented assumptions (T-bill sleeve ~4.3%, private-credit sleeve 9-11%); (2) the 15 bps Treasury fee flow traces from distribution to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac; (3) risk budgets stated: min capital $500, max_alloc_pct 0.10.
Constraints: fee applies to distributions only, not deposits or AUM.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Scaffold P08 repo layout and wire interfaces
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p08/, src/sincor2/defi/p08_rwa/, tests/pytest/test_p08_*, configs/agents/p08-compliance-agent.yaml.
Acceptance criteria: (1) full tree exists with imports resolving; (2) interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24 with zero errors; (3) test stubs are collected by pytest with zero collection errors.
Constraints: module layout mirrors src/sincor2/defi/yield_aggregator.py conventions.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: RWAVault skeleton and compliance-agent starter code
description:
Deliverable: RWAVault.sol skeleton (ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, non-bricking try/catch) plus the Python compliance-agent skeleton with TOA hooks.
Acceptance criteria: (1) compiles under solc 0.8.24; (2) agent boots and answers a health ping; (3) stub test green in CI.
Constraints: EXECUTE_LIVE env pattern reused from yield_aggregator.py; no live paths in the skeleton.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: ComplianceGate contract: 4-check gate, yield-only-after-gate
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p08/ComplianceGate.sol enforcing compliance_pack.
Acceptance criteria: (1) all yield functions revert unless all 4 checks pass (KYC flags true, attestation <= 24h old, NAV deviation < 2%, sanctions blocklist clear); (2) capital stays dry-run until the documented gate payload plus 48h timelock promotion; (3) no call path can accrue yield pre-gate, proven by test.
Constraints: gate evaluation atomic in one call; promotion idempotent.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: RWAVault core: ERC-4626 shares, deposits, redemption
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p08/RWAVault.sol with deposit, share accounting, redemption.
Acceptance criteria: (1) share math matches the Python reference within 1 wei; (2) redemptions always permitted even when yield is gated; (3) 1,000 dead shares minted to address(0) at deployment neutralizing first-deposit inflation.
Constraints: pull-pattern payouts; principal never pausable.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Dry-run capital manager with atomic promotion ledger
description:
Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p08_rwa/capital.py mirroring deposits in a simulated book with zero on-chain yield exposure.
Acceptance criteria: (1) dry-run ledger reconciles to vault state to the wei before and after promotion; (2) promotion is atomic and idempotent (re-call is a no-op); (3) pre-promotion simulated yield never touches a live path.
Constraints: shadow NAV pricing runs against the dry-run book only.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: KYC flag registry with attestation and revocation
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p08/KYCRegistry.sol consulted by the gate on every yield path.
Acceptance criteria: (1) revoked flags block yield immediately while principal stays redeemable; (2) admin attestation flow is 48h-timelocked; (3) registry events are queryable for audit.
Constraints: revocation freezes yield, never principal.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Python compliance agent: pack assembly, gate submission, monitoring
description:
Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p08_rwa/agent.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) agent assembles compliance packs (KYC attestations, custodian PoR, NAV report, geo list, SINAX bytecode proof) and submits gate requests; (2) gate-pass and gate-fail fixtures complete with full error handling; (3) TOA telemetry emitted per cycle.
Constraints: agent never signs promotions; it proposes, the multisig disposes.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Post-gate yield accrual with pull-pattern distribution
description:
Deliverable: yield accrual in RWAVault.sol activating only after gate pass, with pull-style claims.
Acceptance criteria: (1) pre-gate accrual is exactly zero under all paths; (2) post-gate accrual matches the reference model within 1 wei; (3) a reverting recipient blocks only their own claim, never the payout run.
Constraints: 15 bps of each distribution swept to Treasury in the same call.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: RWA vault edge cases: revocation, write-downs, queues, stale oracles
description:
Deliverable: edge-case handling plus docs/ops/p08-edge-cases.md incident write-ups.
Acceptance criteria: (1) gate revocation mid-accrual freezes yield, keeps principal redeemable; (2) asset write-down > 5% in one NAV update pauses accrual pending multisig resume; (3) redemption queue under compliance review settles T+2; oracle data > 36h old reverts.
Constraints: each case has a dedicated test and a written incident playbook.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Unit tests: gate pass/fail, promotion, revocation, share math
description:
Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p08_unit.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) 100% pass; (2) pre-gate yield paths asserted to revert on every entry point; (3) share math checked against the Python reference within 1 wei.
Constraints: tests run in CI under 5 minutes.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Integration tests: agent-to-vault RWA lifecycle
description:
Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p08_integration.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) full lifecycle green: deposit, dry-run, pack, gate pass, promote, accrue, redeem; (2) gate-fail path keeps capital dry-run with zero yield; (3) 15 bps fee asserted to Treasury on distributions.
Constraints: fixtures use deterministic NAV sequences.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Fuzz and invariant tests for vault safety
description:
Deliverable: fuzz harness over deposits, redemptions, gate transitions.
Acceptance criteria: (1) 10k+ fuzz runs green; (2) invariants hold: no yield pre-gate, share price monotonic post-gate, payouts never bricked; (3) every counterexample fixed and recorded in the report.
Constraints: seed corpus checked in for reproducibility.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Base fork simulation of the RWA vault
description:
Deliverable: fork simulation run plus tests/reports/p08-fork-sim.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) simulation runs against a pinned Base fork block with compliance fixtures; (2) report records accrual, Treasury fees, and reproducible block pins; (3) gate-closed pre-promotion state verified on the fork.
Constraints: block pin documented; re-runnable by a reviewer.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Audit-prep package for RWA vaults
description:
Deliverable: docs/audits/p08/ with frozen code, NatSpec, threat model, gate map.
Acceptance criteria: (1) complete contract inventory with trust assumptions on custodian and oracle; (2) threat model covers gate bypass, KYC oracle compromise, share-price manipulation; (3) every gate check maps to its enforcing line of code.
Constraints: code hash frozen and recorded in the package.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate RWA vault audit findings
description:
Deliverable: fixes for all audit findings with linked regression tests.
Acceptance criteria: (1) zero open high/medium findings; (2) each fix links to its finding ID; (3) regression test per fix passes on the remediated tree.
Constraints: no fix weakens a gate check; re-audit delta noted.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Gas optimization for RWA vault contracts
description:
Deliverable: optimized deposit/accrual/redemption paths plus docs/audits/p08/gas.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) before/after gas report published; (2) zero behavioral change across the full test suite; (3) gate checks not weakened or reordered by optimization.
Constraints: no optimization may remove a require on a yield path.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Technical docs for RWA vaults
description:
Deliverable: docs/p08-rwa-vaults.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a new builder can integrate from the docs alone (contract reference, gate semantics, promotion procedure, compliance model); (2) all references resolve; (3) numeric parameters table matches the spec.
Constraints: docs versioned alongside the frozen code hash.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Agent YAML config and ops runbook
description:
Deliverable: configs/agents/p08-compliance-agent.yaml and docs/ops/p08-runbook.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) agent boots from the YAML in dry-run; (2) runbook covers gate submission, revocation response, and promotion; (3) revocation and write-down incidents have step-by-step playbooks.
Constraints: YAML defaults keep capital dry-run.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Dashboard and monitoring hooks for gate, KYC, capital, fees
description:
Deliverable: status-feed hooks exposing gate status, KYC flags, dry-run vs live capital, accrual, Treasury fees.
Acceptance criteria: (1) feed reports real values or 'unknown', never fabricated 'healthy'; (2) dry-run/live capital mismatch raises a P0 alert; (3) payloads validate against STATUS_FEED_SCHEMA.
Constraints: staleness > 60s marks values unknown.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Testnet deploy scripts for RWA vaults
description:
Deliverable: scripts/deploy/p08/ targeting Base Sepolia.
Acceptance criteria: (1) scripts are idempotent; (2) deployed with capital in dry-run and gate closed; addresses, gate state, and dry-run ledger recorded; (3) yield path reverts pre-gate on the deployed contracts.
Constraints: no mainnet addresses in scripts; Sepolia only.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Mainnet readiness checklist for RWA vaults
description:
Deliverable: docs/ops/p08-mainnet-checklist.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) checklist signed off by the auditor task; (2) covers audit sign-off, compliance pack requirements, key custody, legal review; (3) no mainnet promotion without a gate pass.
Constraints: live_blocked=true until every item passes with evidence links.
Reference: per specs/p08-rwa-vaults.md §Acceptance criteria.
